A '''deepdock complex''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], part of the [[deepdock fleet]] formation. They were immense structures acting as floating [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] dedicated to repairing and modifying [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. They were known to possess over a hundred repair bays as well as hyperdrive engines for easy relocation.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
